evidence: Engraved on p690 (not p689; p689 holds only the solemn tone, ref 'CAO 1356; AM 173 & 178', under 'Antiphonae finales ad Beatam Mariam Virginem'), labelled '[simpl.]', mode 5, C clef, no flat: 'Alma * Redemptoris Mater, quae pervia caeli porta manes, et stella maris, succurre cadenti, surgere qui curat populo; tu quae genuisti, natura mirante, tuum sanctum Genitorem, Virgo prius ac posterius, Gabriele ab ore sumens illud Ave, peccatorum miserere.' Opening neumes low-then-rising (c ef gh, g) with Re-demptoris on a repeated g, matching 16751 'Alma Redemptoris (tonus simplex)' c4 'AL(c!ef!gh)ma(g.) * Red(g)emp(g)to(h)ris(i)'; 16751 is tied to AM 1934 p178, the simple-tone page cited by OCO. Label for director: '[simpl.]', modus 5 -> option_txt 'Tonus simplex (modus 5)'. Solemn tone (r6190, cb3 'AL(d.0f!gwhh...') is different melody.
